capabilityProvisioning.read: exclusive handle with final-path, owner, protected-DACL, regular-file, and bounded-length verification before reading from that same handle
capabilityProvisioning.plaintextDelivery: inherited only by the WPF-owned child; the launcher has no plaintext file fallback

identity.concurrency: after the local request guard, identity proof is served outside the protected-request concurrency budget so authenticated ownership remains provable while protected work is busy

busyCompatibility.exactError: The local AI companion is busy.
busyCompatibility.meaning: an unauthenticated availability hint only; never identity proof
busyCompatibility.wpf: retry the identity challenge a bounded number of times without launching a replacement, sending sensitive data, or publishing a durable reservation; keep proof mismatch and a different process classified as untrusted

requests.replay: reject a timestamp and nonce pair after its first valid use within the same server epoch

tunnel.plaintext: JSON containing uppercase method, exact pathAndQuery, optional base64url body, and optional idempotency key

durableEnqueue.ordering: after ownership proof and exact feature validation, publish the durable inbox item before sending an encrypted bodyless recovery-aware wake carrying only its idempotency key; the companion recovers an interrupted running row before draining the inbox
durableEnqueue.receipt: the companion drains the durable inbox after recovery before returning the matching job receipt
durableEnqueue.postPublishUnauthenticatedFailure: return SavedForDelivery and recover using the same request id; only an authenticated inner 4xx is authoritative

startup.applicationLaunch: ordinary WPF launch and passive viewing do not start Node.js or the Companion; passive readers may use an already-running authenticated Companion but do not launch a replacement; only an explicit Enhancement action may start the exact authenticated API child
startup.explicitBackendPreparation: after one-time interrupted-job recovery and the complete committed durable-Inbox drain, the worker passively rereads the final visible durable queue head and may restore the already configured read-only MiniMax H3 runtime mounts only when that head is one exact executable H3 row; a deeper H3 row, non-H3 head, paused queue, or unknown or malformed head performs no H3 path, runtime-status, seal, or mount access, and startup and passive reads never perform preparation
startup.explicitRecoveryProcessSemantics: successful interrupted-job recovery runs at most once per companion process and concurrent or repeated authenticated requests reuse that result; authenticated recovery and wake actions defer new claims while draining the complete committed durable Inbox, then wake the worker once, while a request carrying an idempotency key returns the matching receipt
startup.authenticatedQueueResume: POST /api/enhance/queue with paused=false completes the same one-time interrupted-job recovery and committed durable-Inbox drain before persisting resume; the resumed worker performs final-head backend preparation before claim, while paused=true remains available without preparation or recovery so a running worker can be stopped at the next job boundary

server.responseLimitEnforcement: reject oversized Content-Length before reading and cancel an unknown-length stream as soon as the running total exceeds the limit or the client disconnects

wpf.ownership: verify HMAC, instance id, live process id, and process start time before explicit enqueue, and bind every encrypted request and authenticated response to that exact server epoch
wpf.closeLifetime: if this WPF instance started the exact Companion process and no authenticated non-GET request was constructed, closing WPF stops only that exact owned process tree; after an authenticated mutation or recovery request can activate durable work, WPF releases its process wrapper so accepted queued or running work may continue; a listener or process not started by this WPF instance is never signalled
wpf.listenerHandoff: a replacement listener receives only an epoch-bound encrypted envelope and its response is rejected without the response proof
wpf.unknownListener: fail closed before source identity, prompt, settings, credential, job body, or durable reservation
